verdict.rationale: SigNoz documents filtering traces by any span attribute and breaking dashboard panels out by an attribute, with ClickHouse SQL available for ad-hoc queries. That covers ad-hoc filter and group-by on arbitrary attributes. Nothing addresses high-cardinality fields such as user or request IDs specifically, or confirms that no indexes or pre-aggregation are needed. missing for 10: explicit high-cardinality group-by/filter documentation, confirmation that no index or pre-aggregation setup is required, hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can group and filter by high-cardinality fields (user id, request id) without pre-aggregating or defining indexes first

citations.quote: Search and filter traces by service, operation, duration, or any span attribute.
Drill down from any panel: jump into the underlying logs and traces, break out by an attribute
Use the Metrics Explorer to query and visualize data with a visual builder or advanced query languages like PromQL and ClickHouse SQL.
